title: Culture and Differentiation of Primary Human Tracheobronchial Epithelial Cells Using STEMCELL Technologies Pneumacult Media
protocol: Thaw the 50X supplement at room temperature.
Mix the contents of the 50X supplement with Ex-Plus Basal medium.
Add 0.5 mL of hydrocortisone stock solution to the supplemented medium.
Sterile filter the mixture through a 0.22 μm vacuum filtration bottle and store at 4°C for up to one month.
Thaw the 10X Supplement overnight at 4°C.
Mix the thawed 10X Supplement with ALI base medium to prepare complete base medium.
Prepare maintenance medium by adding 1 mL of 100X Maintenance supplement, 0.2 mL of heparin solution, and 0.5 mL of hydrocortisone stock solution to 100 mL of complete base medium.
Sterile filter the mixture through a 0.22 μm vacuum filtration bottle and store at 4°C for up to two weeks.
Prepare the required volume of ALI maintenance medium by adjusting the above volumes accordingly.
Warm Pneumacult Ex-Plus growth medium to 37 °C and prepare materials prior to obtaining a vial of cells from cryostorage.
Remove vial from liquid nitrogen and thaw in 37 °C water bath (1-2 min).
Add 24 mL of growth medium to a 50 mL conical tube then transfer the thawed cells from the cryovial into the growth medium using a P1000 pipette and gently mix by inverting 10 times.
Pellet cells via centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature in centrifuge with a swinging bucket rotor.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant.
Gently resuspend the cells in pre-warmed growth medium and transfer to a flask.
Distribute cell suspension on the dish through gentle rocking and swirling for approximately 15 seconds.
Place in a tissue culture incubator overnight.
Check cells the following day for attachment to the dish.
Aspirate and replace medium.
Pre-warm Pneumacult ALI growth medium and DPBS in a 37 °C water bath for approximately 30 minutes.
Pre-warm trypsin aliquot at room temperature for approximately 30 minutes.
Aspirate growth medium from flasks to be passaged.
Add trypsin-EDTA solution to the flasks.
Place flasks with trypsin-EDTA solution in a tissue culture incubator for 2-3 minutes.
When approximately 80-90% of the cells are detached, add a half volume of SBTI to the flask.
Pipette up the trypsin/SBTI mixture and rinse the vessel bottom.
Transfer the cells to a sterile centrifuge tube.
Pellet cells at 200-600 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature in a centrifuge with a swinging bucket rotor.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Triturate the cells with a serological pipet to create a homogeneous suspension.
Determine cell viability by diluting a sample of the cells with an equal volume of trypan blue.
Adjust the number of cells to approximately 1.0x10^6/mL.
Re-pellet the cells if the density is less than 1.0x10^6/mL and suspend in the appropriate volume.
Dilute the cell suspension with the appropriate volume of medium if the density is greater than 1.0x10^6/mL.
Seed cells at a typical density of 0.5 x 10^4 cells/cm^2.
Seed more heavily if desired.
Change the medium every other day until cells reach approximately 70% confluence.
Replace the medium more frequently for denser cultures as needed.
Passage further for culture when approaching confluence.
Plate on Transwell inserts for ALI differentiation when approaching confluence.
Cryopreserve upon reaching confluence.
Trypsinize and collect cells from expansion flasks as described in steps #1-9 of the “Passaging and Expansion of pHBEC” section above.

Starting with a cell density of 1.0x10^6 cells/mL, prepare a volume and dilution of cell suspension according to the size and number of Transwell inserts needed based on the seeding density and volume table below.
Prepare a volume of diluted cell suspension that is greater than the exact amount needed for the desired plating to account for volume loss and/or slight variations in pipetting.
Allow cells to adhere to Transwell inserts for 16-24 hours.
Aspirate medium to remove nonadherent cells after the adhesion period.
Add fresh Pneumacult Ex-Plus growth medium in the apical compartment.
Continue to grow cells in Pneumacult Ex-Plus growth medium until confluent.
Withdraw apical medium once cells are confluent.
Replace basolateral medium with Pneumacult ALI differentiation medium.
Replace the Pneumacult ALI differentiation medium in the basolateral compartment every 48 hours.
Wash the apical surface with DPBS at least once per week.
Trypsinize and collect cells from expansion flasks.
Pellet cells again at 200-600 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature in a centrifuge with a swinging bucket rotor.
Resuspend the pellet in CryStor10 Freezing Medium at a minimum of 1.0x10^6 cells/mL.
Gently mix by pipetting.
Transfer 1.0 mL of the cell suspension to each cryovial.
Place cryovials in a Mr. Frosty freezing container filled with isopropyl alcohol and place in a -80 °C freezer overnight.
Transfer the frozen vials to liquid nitrogen storage.
